question: Show all measurements from sensor 3.0 in epoch 25.
graph_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: "3.0"})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
MATCH (m)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: 25})
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id,
       m.time AS time,
       m.temperature AS temperature,
       m.humidity AS humidity,
       m.light AS light,
       m.voltage AS voltage
ORDER BY m.time ASC, mote_id ASC
LIMIT 20

gold_row.question: Show all measurements from sensor 3.0 in epoch 25.
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 3})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
MATCH (m)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: 25})
WITH m, s
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id, m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature, m.humidity AS humidity, m.light AS light, m.voltage AS voltage ORDER BY time, mote_id LIMIT 20
